answer: Make identity a cultivated history, not a cheap mint. Each agent earns a pearl of standing only by answering personalized challenges seeded from its own prior work, so its record grows like a vine rooted to one lineage. Replaying another path fails the seed check, so a sybil must independently cultivate M full histories = linear cost. Peers grade each answer for coherence, a sonnet-tight test of originality, so one backend wearing many masks yields correlated prose and loses every clone's accrued standing at once.
